description: HotPads rental listings for a US city: building or home name, type (apartment complex, house...), street address, city, ZIP, bedrooms, rent range (USD per month), image and link, about 40 per page (page 1 to 20), plus the total number of rentals. Filter by apartments, houses, condos or townhomes. From hotpads.com's public search pages via a residential proxy. Related tools on this server, for a different need: realestate_openrent when you need UK rental listings from OpenRent for a city or area; realestate_immowelt when you need German property listings from immowelt.de for a city: per. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. tx
